body:
Dedup keywords: `check-type-check-coverage` · DEBT · TEST_DEBT · closing keyword · differential emitter scan

Surfaced by the `os-dev` seat delivering objectui#9538 (PR objectui#9595); filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat. ⛔ Unassigned and ungraded. Class **(a)** — reproducible defect, plus a structural ask.

## Part 1 — the sibling gate carries two more sites (DORMANT)

`scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`, the documented sibling of the gate objectui#9595 repairs, spells a GitHub **closing keyword immediately before an interpolated anchor** at **two** stale-entry sites. One of them is a **byte-identical twin** of the tail objectui#9595 just replaced.

Both its ledgers (`DEBT`, `TEST_DEBT`) are empty today, so both sites are **dormant** — exactly the status objectui#9538's site had. ⛔ Dormant is not fixed: it is one ledger entry away from rendering. ⚠️ Contrast objectui#9597, whose ledger is **non-empty** with an **open** anchor — that one is live and should be graded above this.

⭐ **Cheaper to pin than objectui#9595 was:** this gate already exports its collector and audit, so a rendered pin can drive them with seeded tables directly, without the copy-gate-into-a-throwaway-workspace harness objectui#9595 had to build.

## Part 2 — the structural ask: this is the THIRD one-site-at-a-time repair

objectui#9535, objectui#9595, and now objectui#9597 plus this card. The shape keeps getting written into new emitters because **nothing stops it being written**.

Proposed: one **differential, branch-scoped** gate over text **emitted by** `scripts/`, modelled on `scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` (which is already the repo's precedent for "new instances only, not a bulk sweep"), so a new emitter cannot carry the shape at all.

⚠️ **Two design constraints, both measured rather than assumed:**

1. **The matcher must collapse template-literal concatenation and backslash-n escapes before matching.** `check-action-forward-parity.mjs` splits the sentence across concatenated chunks, so a single-line `git grep` sees only part of it — this is precisely why three repairs failed to find it. A naive scanner will **under-count and report a false zero**.
2. **`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` must be excluded by name.** It contains many instances of the shape inside its own self-test corpus for the closing-keyword detector it implements — deliberate and correct, the same documented status as the `CLAIM_DEBT` exclusion in `check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs`. A sweep that does not know this reads them all as findings.

⛔ **Deliberately NOT implemented by the objectui#9538 dev, and the reason is correct:** a new `check:*` registration plus a new workflow would have overturned that card's declared `Clause-②: no`. It was reported instead of reshaped. ⇒ Part 2 is a **new gate registration and CI surface**, so it is the maintainer's call, ⛔ not an execution-seat one. Part 1 is ordinary work and does not wait on it.

**Provenance:** measured by the `os-dev` seat on objectui#9538 (report `5693776479`), which found the sites and declined to widen its own pull request. Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat, `session_01B3CJWyNjMW4RvN5MeXEupE`, 2026-09-16T07:4xZ.
